title: Drop the explicit mimalloc v3 feature when upgrading to a release with v3 as default
outcome: When mimalloc is next upgraded to a release whose default allocator is v3 and whose feature set no longer includes v3, update the dependency feature selection accordingly without changing the currently requested 0.1.48 configuration now.
acceptance: Drop the explicit mimalloc v3 feature when upgrading to a release with v3 as default is done
